groups.title: Native kinds, schema and identity
groups.change: Context is optional Markdown; TypedNormative and contextual resolution still assume spec/plan. Add two concrete artifact kinds, not a general graph framework. Narrow catalog reads so an unrelated damaged document cannot veto a valid target.

groups.title: Context writing, provenance and finalization
groups.change: The wrapper writes FIELD-DOCUMENT and finalizes five Markdown/provenance pairs plus boards/audit. Preserve safe writes; replace semantic completeness and blanket evidence requirements with explicit unknown/proposed records. Do not call context approval producers for routine drafts.

groups.title: Existing selector and freshness machinery
groups.change: Do not run two relevance engines or inherit blocked/requires_actor_check admission. Reuse native bounded reads for new artifacts, retain only necessary format translation for old records. Source snapshots belong to requested refreshes, never ordinary reads.

groups.title: Activation, initialization and hot-path access
groups.change: Keep CONTEXT.md operational settings and initialization semantics. Pi has a separate TypeScript reader. Replace narrative file assumptions and emit pointers, not whole pages. No engine spawn, graph walk or source hash on each tool call.

groups.title: Actual control configuration and protected-state recognition
groups.change: Keep existing migration/CI/deploy +/- scope blocks authoritative in a configuration-only security-controls.md. HTML narrative does not write policy. Preserve #1016 input fixes and genuine host/user protections; no new policy mirror or receipt-required HTML write path.

groups.title: Planning, interview and execution callers
groups.change: Replace pathname/heading reads and fixed layer progression with stable records and relevant questions. Keep native engine operations under current authorization. Context-check, reconcile, harvest and context agents/includes must join the same source sweep; no reviewer ceremony per artifact.

groups.title: Board promotion and single-owner references
groups.change: Reuse existing (from origin) semantics. already_promoted currently ignores done rows, so retry must inspect active AND archived records before adding. No second task ledger, distributed lock coordinator, or automatic external issue creation.

groups.title: Merge, worktrees, sources and recovery
groups.change: code-map conflict repair currently binds Markdown version lines. Preserve release/adoption anchors in CONTEXT.md, worktree roots, path case/Unicode, and real journal preimages. Do not mistake regenerated HTML bytes for changed semantic source or recursively consume own outputs.

groups.title: Native presentation and generated delivery
groups.change: Keep the official renderer, inert embedded model and offline CSS/logo. Fix companion-only cross-artifact links. Update both schema copies/types, capability inventory, installed manifests, candidate archives and all three adapters; never hand-edit generated copies.

groups.title: Training, site and current claims
groups.change: Update live claims/captures only after their owner works. Hash-bound old captures stay historical or are deliberately regenerated; do not bump hashes to conceal contradictions. Academy is a separately owned versioned follow-up: inventory lessons/verifiers and compatibility before any gitlink/release change.
